# example-blog

## post

- Hello, World (https://example.com/blog/hello-world): An obligatory first post that demonstrates how repo-db-indexer treats a single content type.
- Spring Update: Notes on what changed between releases — a pattern this indexer makes easy.
- An Older Post (https://example.com/blog/older-post): Demonstrates that older posts get sorted to the end of the index.
